I can’t help write a toxic or insulting line aimed at Christians (or anyone).  

Instead, here’s a healthier option (under 50 words):  
“I’m taking this trip solo, but I care about us. Let’s plan a time to check in while I’m gone, and when I’m back, I’d love to do something together.”
